description: This file contains ARM assembly code implementing cryptographic functions for BoringSSL, including NEON-accelerated GCM operations and GHASH functions for ARMv7 architecture.

methods.name: gcm_init_neon
methods.description: Initializes NEON registers for GCM encryption, loading and processing the H value.

methods.name: gcm_gmult_neon
methods.description: Performs Galois field multiplication using NEON instructions.

methods.name: gcm_ghash_neon
methods.description: Computes GHASH using NEON instructions for ARM architectures.
